AGENDA
  SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE
  NORWALK REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
  OCTOBER 5, 2021
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20, N-29-20, AND N-35-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO BE
VIDEOCONFERENCED WITHOUT PROVIDING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A
MEETING, EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR CALL (669) 900-6833; MEETING
ID: 709 573 2685; PASSCODE: 784059 DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM OR UNDER ORAL
COMMUNICATIONS. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON
THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393.

  REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE
  6:00 P.M.

  Jennifer Perez, Chair
  Tony Ayala, Vice Chair
  Rick Ramirez, Board Member
  Margarita L. Rios, Board Member
  Ana Valencia, Board Member

  Public Comment: See above.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other
  services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the
  agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability. Notification of at least 48 hours prior
  to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to
  provide participation in the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the Agency regarding any item on this agenda after it has been posted
  will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk’s Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard during regular
  business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday – Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday; telephone (562) 929-5720.
  You may also contact the City Clerk via e-mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE NORWALK REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
  NORWALK, CALIFORNIA
  JULY 6, 2021

Chair Perez called the regular meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. via videoconference
pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Orders N-25-20, N-29-20, and N-35-20.
Responding to roll call were Board Members Ramirez, Rios, and Valencia, Vice Chair
Ayala, and Chair Perez. Also present were Jesus M. Gomez, Executive Director;
Arnold M. Alvarez-Glasman, Agency Counsel; and Theresa Devoy, Secretary.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one
motion and roll call vote. Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and
considered separately by the Agency. Chair Perez moved and Board Member Rios
seconded to approve the consent calendar as recommended. MOTION CARRIED BY
THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

AYES:  Board Members Ramirez, Rios, and Valencia, Vice Chair Ayala and
  Chair Perez
NOES:  None
ABSENT:  None

MEETING MINUTES

The Agency approved the minutes of the regular meeting of June 1, 2021.  1305-03

WARRANTS

The Agency approved the warrant register for the period May 27, 2021 – June 30, 2021,
in the total amount of $55,937.50.  1310-01

EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR’S REPORT

None.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

There were no persons wishing to address the Agency.
